mainEntity.name: What happens if the mentor doesn't answer?

acceptedAnswer.text: The mentor has 7 days from your payment. If there is no answer by then, you are refunded in full automatically.

Every mentor passes an ID and selfie check, must be 18 or older, their name must match their ID, and a person on our team reviews their experience and evidence. Medicine, law and finance also need a licence we check in the official register.

mainEntity.name: How much does a question cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Each mentor sets their own price, between 5 and 2,000 GEL per question. You see it before you pay.

mainEntity.name: Can I get a refund after an answer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, in full, if the answer is spam, empty, off-topic or breaks our rules and you tell us within 7 days. Disagreeing with an answer is not a reason for a refund.
